detail: Fresh GitHub clone test cannot run until origin/main exists. When the push completes: clone into a new temp dir, run npm ci + build + index build + npm test + smoke, assert 0 files matching *.sqlite/*.sqlite3/*.db, and boot the app (no SQLite dependency).
